cohort: Women who gave birth at Aleppo University Hospital and Damascus University Hospital in Syria during 2021.
finding: The prevalence of C-sections was 47.4%, with 68% being repeat procedures, and fetal distress identified as the most common indication for CS.
mod_finding: Most primary C-sections were medically indicated (85.2%), while 14.8% were non-indicated, often due to maternal requests or previous complicated births.
